intent: Audit a lean candidate-variant diagnostic against product04, explicitly separating composition effects from validation and format-repair differences.

configuration.target: qwen3.5-flash; temperature0.3; thinking=false; max_tokens100; three repetitions; unchanged retry/concurrency settings

exact_composition_review.digest_method: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of all61 messagesFor(case, candidate, exact candidate04 policy, v2, false) arrays in frozen case order.
exact_composition_review.preservation: Every lean user JSON is exactly c.input, and every lean room JSON is exactly the same configured role plus full inventory. No evaluator labels/checks or expected behavior are included.
exact_composition_review.system_changes: Replace generated base room guidance with short tutor identity and role/inventory JSON, retain candidate04 verbatim, and append runner contractV2. This removes role-style, communication/cognitive/emotional guidance, learning-process duplication, reading advice, teaching-method descriptions, generic detection/privacy/default-safe-action sections and closing room guidance. The generic contract is an additional instruction, not merely deleted text.
exact_composition_review.user_changes: Lean serializes raw c.input after a combined introductory line. Product uses the ecological builder, normalizes null prior_mode to unknown and adds interaction_mode single_agent. After accounting for those two JSON differences, all61 input payloads agree. All scenario, history and latest learner text remain unchanged.

adapter_factors.evidence: runner.js targetFormatValid uses metrics.contractValidityV2 for candidate, while product uses product-adapter.productionValid and parseTutorDecision.
adapter_factors.difference: Candidate metric accepts legacy reasoning/suggested_response extra fields and agent-tagged replies that the production parser rejects. Candidate generation also does not reject parseable output solely because finish_reason is length.

adapter_factors.evidence: runner.js generateTarget selects a different repair path by variant.
adapter_factors.difference: Candidate appends the failed answer as an assistant turn and a new user schema/repair instruction. Product appends its actual repair instruction to the existing last user turn without supplying the failed answer. Both use two target attempts, but their repair requests differ.
Only product adds a production-invalid error marker after the second invalid output. Candidate deterministic contract diagnostics can fail without that product marker.

independent_probes.input: Valid v2 plus legacy reasoning field
Parseable valid v2 with finish_reason length

assessment: Removing the lengthy inherited prompt layer is a reasonable diagnostic after recurrent ordinary classification errors. Existing candidate variant tests a bundle of lean composition, generic contract emphasis, user normalization and repair/parser differences. It cannot isolate contradictory base guidance as the cause. There is no case-specific answer insertion or outcome selection in this composition.
required_reporting: Record every composition and adapter factor above before execution; describe this as a bundled diagnostic, not exact production parity or an isolated base-prefix ablation.

Retain every raw target and attempt without outcome-based retries or selection. Report first-attempt classification separately from final repaired classification so changed repair prompts are visible.

Independently apply the production parser and finish_reason check to final outputs and report those counts alongside candidate contract validity. Do not describe candidate-format-valid outputs as production-valid.

Preserve original-setting product04 failures. A promising lean diagnostic requires a newly matched baseline, unchanged full semantic/holdout validation and actual production integration before acceptance or release.
controls: Candidate04 policy, cases, role/inventory, expected labels, settings-r3 and v1.1 gates stay fixed. No live source edits are needed to execute this diagnostic.
